\[
I_{\text{out}}(x,y) = \operatorname{median}\,\{\, I(x+i,\, y+j) \;:\; -r \le i \le r,\; -r \le j \le r \,\},
\qquad
r = (3 - 1) / 2
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(I\): Input channel value
- \(I_{\text{out}}\): Output channel value
- \((x, y)\): Pixel position
- \(r\): Window radius in pixels

The filter collects the window values, sorts them and takes the middle one. The window size is odd, so there is always exactly one middle value and it is one of the input values.
